subject: Post-discovery: calendar orchestration for demo + security & procurement
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@olivetech.com>, Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.i@olivetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: calendar orchestration for demo + security & procurement

Hi Samira / Rajesh —

Great to speak earlier — thanks for walking us through OliveTech's latency-sensitive search use case and the expected Q4 rollout. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock calendars: 

- Recap: primary goal is to replace current on-prem inference pipeline to reduce per-query latency and cut hosting costs by ~30%. Security and procurement will need to review our compliance posture and commercial terms.
- Next step: 60-minute technical demo + ops deep dive (target audience: platform eng, security, procurement).
- Proposed windows (PT):
  * Thu 9/16 10:00–11:00 PT
  * Fri 9/17 08:00–09:00 PT
  * Mon 9/20 14:00–15:00 PT

Can you confirm which of those work? I’m cc'ing Marissa (your lead AE) so she can start drafting a mutual action plan. If helpful, we can do a short 20-min security-only sync first — Naomi on my team handles SOC2/controls and can join. I’ll attach the brief security questionnaire we discussed.

Attachments: redwood-security-questionnaire.pdf (stub), OliveTech-MAP-v1.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priya.n@redwood.com
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@olivetech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.i@olivetech.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 18:11:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: calendar orchestration for demo + security & procurement

Thanks Priya — this is perfect. Quick answers:

- Thu 9/16 10:00 PT works for our platform team (Rajesh) — please hold that if possible.
- Procurement (Ana at ProcureCo) is looped on our side; I’ll intro her in a follow-up once we confirm the tech session timing.
- Security: we’d prefer a short 20-min security-only sync before the demo so our InfoSec can triage questions; Rajesh will share their availability.

Two requests:
1) Please include a short agenda for the 60-min demo (high-level bullets) so we can invite the right folks.
2) Any compliance artifacts you can share ahead of the security sync would help speed the review.

Appreciate it — Samira

We’ll also finalize the 60-min demo for Thu 9/16 10:00 PT if security is fine.

Marissa — can you draft a short agenda for the 60-min session (I’ll paste below suggested bullets) and hold Thu 10:00 PT as tentative?

Suggested 60-min demo agenda (high level):
- 10 min: short recap + success metrics
- 20 min: architecture walkthrough (Redwood serving runtime, routing, caching)
- 15 min: Q&A focused on latency/throughput and KV cache use
- 15 min: next steps / mutual action plan timeline/costing assumptions

Hi Samira / Priya —

Thanks for the note. I can do a 20-min security triage tomorrow 9/15 at 10:30 PT. Quick notes before we talk so you can prep:

- Please have a list of the environments (cloud regions / on-prem) you plan to use and expected data flows.
- I attached a 1-page SOC2 summary and our standard data retention/ingress matrix for quick reference.
- We typically ship the security questionnaire answers within 48–72 hours after the triage if there are no major gaps.

If Ana from procurement wants to join the wider demo on Thu 9/16, that’s fine — Marissa, can you include procurement in the invite once Samira confirms?

Cheers, Naomi

Confirming the full demo for Thu 9/16 10:00–11:00 PT is a go for our team (Rajesh, platform; Ana, procurement) — invite sent.

Next items:
- Redwood: please upload the completed security questionnaire and the short agenda to the HubSpot deal record (link below).
- OliveTech: Ana will run standard procurement checklist once the draft MSA is on DocuSign.

Thanks all — see you on the demo.

Samira
